payload.description_html: Heinrich Harder (1858 – 1935) mural of Pareiasaurus, an extinct genus of anapsid reptile from the Permian period, at the Berlin Aquarium. Heinrich Harder (2 June 1858 Putzar – 5 February 1935 Berlin) was a German artist and an art professor at the Prussian Academy of Arts in Berlin
